info.title: Atlas Health Services — Clinical Peptides, Protocols & Dosing Calculator API
info.description: Public read-only clinical peptide directory, protocol explorer, and deterministic U-100 / click-dial dosing calculator for ChatGPT GPT Actions and AI assistants.

get.summary: Search Atlas Health Services clinical peptide vials, dosages, and B2B schedules

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Peptide name, blend, or indication keyword (e.g., BPC-157, Tirzepatide, GHK-Cu, NAD+, MOTS-c)

parameters.name: specialty
parameters.description: Optional clinical specialty filter (e.g., longevity, metabolic, gynecology, dermatology, urology)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-60)

200.description: Matching clinical peptide specifications and monograph links

get.summary: Search published clinical peptide and longevity protocols

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Protocol name, goal, or pathway keyword

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of protocols to return (1-50)

200.description: Published clinical protocol summaries and URLs

get.summary: Calculate exact U-100 insulin syringe units, draw volume (mL), and 3 mL click-dial clicks

parameters.name: vialMg
parameters.description: Total peptide mass in the vial or pen cartridge (mg), e.g., 10

parameters.name: diluentMl
parameters.description: Bacteriostatic water or cartridge volume (mL), e.g., 2

parameters.name: targetDoseMcg
parameters.description: Desired single dose in micrograms (mcg), e.g., 250

200.description: Exact concentration, draw volume (mL), U-100 units, and doses per container
